title: Gibson Tony Iommi Signature Humbucker Pickup, Chrome

long_description.body:
Tony Iommi’s iconic riffs, heavy tones, and massively influential albums created the blueprint for heavy metal and many other genres to follow. His career, like the man himself, is universally loved and revered. In the late 1990s, Gibson worked with Tony to develop the first-ever Gibson signature pickup. Now, Gibson’s first signature humbucker™ is back! The Tony Iommi Humbucker features an exclusive configuration of powerful ceramic and Alnico 2 magnets and special windings that give it the incredible tone and sustain that have made Tony’s work with Black Sabbath instantly recognizable. Full-shred tone, incredible sustain, with crystal clarity, even in full distortion. The Tony Iommi Humbucker is fully wax-potted and epoxied for absolute protection against unwanted feedback. The 4-conductor wiring allows for series, parallel, and split coil operation.






Position: Any






Magnets: Alnico 2 and Ceramic






Wiring: 4-Conductor






Cover: Chrome






Wax Potted






Average DC Resistance: 16k






Details: Gibson’s first-ever artist signature pickup returns, with powerful ceramic and Alnico 2 magnets, special windings, and incredible tone, sustain, and clarity.



Model: PUTIHBCC4
